MemoryLayer.grounding: F24 names memory as a distinct resolution state; F3 makes a recorded residue the canonical memory repair when current quotient data is insufficient for the declared future probe.

HiddenUpstreamRole.grounding: F24 names hidden upstream role; F13a defines hiddenness by a predictive surplus inside a current fiber and a typed minimal upstream determining state.

BridgeMediatedRole.grounding: F24 names mediation by declared bridge data; F22 gives the empty-obstruction criterion for an explicit mediation map; F51 gives the common-refinement form for one parent quotient projecting to child quotients and compatible statuses.

BudgetedRole.grounding: F24 names budgeted residual status; F6 requires declared currency/residual budgets for accepted layer-boundary moves; F9 requires every native residual to carry a typed status.

ScopedRole.grounding: F24 names scope as a resolution state; F52 treats declared scope and in-scope/named-outside direction coverage as part of closure completeness.

CoarsenedRole.grounding: F24 names coarsening as a resolution state; F2 identifies minimal target coarsening as a canonical descent repair; F39 records the fiber/target-obstruction behavior under coarsening.

OutsideRoleScope.grounding: F24 names outside-scope exclusion; F52 requires claimed directions to be either in scope or named outside.

BlockedNonClosure.grounding: F24 names blocked nonclosure as the remaining status family; F9 and F52 make an unformed, inadequately statused residual a closure-boundary failure rather than an accepted resolution.
